title: Apple launches a wave of new devices: iPhone 17e, MacBook Neo, and a new iPad Air! 🍏
body: Apple launches a wave of new devices: iPhone 17e, MacBook Neo, and a new iPad Air! 🍏

Apple launched this week a broad wave of updates to its devices: the iPhone 17e, a cheaper addition to the iPhone 17 family running on the "A19" chip, a new iPad Air with the "M4" chip, a MacBook Air with the "M5" chip, and a MacBook Pro with the "M5 Pro" and "M5 Max" chips, plus the MacBook Neo, a budget laptop running on the phone's "A18 Pro" chip.

The iPhone 17e is the cheapest member of the family, but it carries the same brain as the new phones — new-phone power at a lower price. And the MacBook Neo is Apple's first budget laptop, using a phone chip to cut the price. "M5" is the new generation of Apple's computer chips. No prices were mentioned in the report, so we are not publishing any price here.
Which device in this wave interests you most? 💻
